== Summary ==
PC Errata 2018 E card of [[Dagobah (Light)]]: the Players Committee's full card image with the corrected text and a white italic “E” in the black lower border. Image for [[Dagobah (Light) (PC Errata 2018 E card)]].

Source: Players Committee Holotable image set, file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Dagobah-Light/large/dagobah.gif</code> as of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 swccgpc/holotable commit 022435b] (8 July 2018), the repository's first import of the image set, so the image itself may be older. Preserved copy of the commit: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive]. Uploaded unchanged (350 × 490 GIF).

SHA-1 <code>600c77bcf27b61c5194bba1fd1f77ebd441fcd4a</code>, SHA-256 <code>0353ca70485f4b3c24463f7d35e98782ea5aae4efa69adc9af803e2e4b2fc87d</code>.

The Players Committee published the same bytes once more on 1 August 2019 under the Ahch-To file name (<code>Virtual11-Light/large/ahchto.gif</code>, commit e26d0f1); that copy is [[:File:V11-L-ahchto-20190801.gif]], the image of [[Ahch-To (Playtest)]]. This file is the Dagobah-Light publication.
